description: Correct which field of a linked log dataset holds a role, such as the customer's user ID, status code or route, or say no field does; later checks keep the choice. Or have Databuddy check the fields again. linkId and current roles from get_log_connection. Preview first; apply after the user approves.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

field.description: The field holding the role, as list_log_sources names it (attributes.user.id), or null when no field does.

linkId.description: Link ID from get_log_connection or list_integrations.

recheck.description: Check the link's fields again from its recent lines, such as after the app changed what it logs.

role.description: What the field holds: user_id, account_id or email name the customer; status, route, latency, level, message, service, error_type, error_stack, api_key_id, request_id, trace_id and time describe the line.

name: update_log_fields

outputSchema.description: message describes the outcome. preview and confirmationRequired identify a review without writing; current and updates show proposed edits when present. link names the website and dataset; fieldRoles and customerFields show the link's fields after the change; success confirms an applied mutation.

title: Update log fields
